hints.title: Only k values matter
hints.body: The k-th largest value is determined by the largest k values in the collection. Values below that group can never affect the answer again.

hints.title: Keep a small heap
hints.body: Maintain a min-heap containing at most the k largest values. The smallest value in this heap is exactly the k-th largest of the whole collection.

hints.title: Add, then trim
hints.body: Push each new value into the heap. If the heap grows beyond k, remove its minimum. After the trim, read the minimum as the current answer. Seed the heap with the initial values using the same procedure.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
heap = empty min-heap
for value in initial:
    push value
    if heap.size > k: pop minimum

answers = []
for value in additions:
    push value
    if heap.size > k: pop minimum
    answers.push(heap.minimum)
return answers
```
